title: Giraffe dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- giraffe dancing -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#f2b134'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='3.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='56' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='3.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='64' r='2.8' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M60 55 Q70 35 66 20 L74 20 Q78 38 68 58 Z' fill='#f2b134'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='32' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='16' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f2b134'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='18' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f7cc6b'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='18' r='1' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='14' r='2' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='72.7' cy='13.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <line x1='66' y1='9' x2='64' y2='2' stroke='#c97a29' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='9' x2='78' y2='2' stroke='#c97a29' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='2' r='2.4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='2' r='2.4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='13' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f2b134' transform='rotate(-20 62 13)'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='12' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f2b134' transform='rotate(20 82 12)'/>
  <!-- dancing legs: front leg raised -->
  <path d='M40 72 Q36 82 30 84' stroke='#f2b134' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='85' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d='M60 72 Q66 82 70 88' stroke='#f2b134' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='90' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- other front leg -->
  <path d='M44 74 Q44 84 46 90' stroke='#e3a02a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='92' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- other back leg -->
  <path d='M56 74 Q54 84 52 90' stroke='#e3a02a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='92' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 58 Q20 56 18 50' stroke='#c97a29' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='49' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- raised arm -->
  <path d='M68 60 Q78 62 82 56' stroke='#f2b134' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#4fd1c5'>
    <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='3'/>
    <rect x='20' y='16' width='2' height='14'/>
    <path d='M22 16 Q28 18 26 24' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#f687b3'>
    <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='2.5'/>
    <rect x='33.8' y='10' width='1.7' height='12'/>
  </g>
</svg>
